cards.name: ICICI Amazon Pay

rules.desc: 5% for Prime members (3% non-Prime) on Amazon.in as Amazon Pay balance; 2% on Amazon Pay partner merchants; 1% elsewhere. Non-Prime 3% not modelled. No cap found.

cards.notes: Official: lifetime free, 5%/3% Amazon, 1% other, forex 1.99%, 1% fuel surcharge waiver, invite-only. Jewellery exclusion is from third-party MCC list (5094 Precious Stones/Metals/Jewelry, 5944 Jewelry Stores) - not on official page. Savesage also lists International, Utilities, Education, Tax as zero-earn; official page says 1% on non-Amazon spends, so conflict on international. Cashback credited as Amazon Pay balance (value Re1). Excluded from Kalyan/Tanishq ICICI offers historically. 2026 changes (third-party reports, Jan 15/Feb 1 2026): 6x accelerated points removed on iShop vouchers incl. Kalyan/Tanishq/Reliance Jewels; jewellery vouchers NetBanking-only (no card payment); 3.5%+GST fee on selected iShop vouchers; 1% fee on wallet loads >= Rs5,000; 2% fee on gaming; 1% fee on transport spend >Rs50k; transport/insurance reward caps; BookMyShow benefit needs Rs25k prior-quarter spend (from 1 Apr 2026 per official pages).
